turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arey yaar, pehle hi bahut bahut mubarak ho Shreya ki shaadi ki! Pandrah saal se sapna dekh rahe ho dono, aur ab waqt aa gaya — yeh khushi hi itni badi hai ki darr natural hai.

Sun, tera darr samajh aa raha hai. Roza hoga, energy levels manage karne padenge, aur opening dance ki pressure alag se. But yeh sab ho sakta hai, trust me.

Kuch cheezein soch:

**Roza aur dance** — bahut log karte hain, especially weddings pe. Bass tera dance practice Ishaari ke baad rakh, ya seheri ke time ke around. Body adjust ho jaati hai. Aur actual sangeet night pe agar energy low lage, toh choreography aise rakh jismein tera portion impactful ho but thaka na de.

**Darr** — yeh darr nahi hai, yeh responsibility ka ehsaas hai. Pandrah saal se plan kar rahi ho, Shreya tujhe apne saath stage pe chahti hai — iska matlab tera presence uske liye emotional comfort hai. Tujhe perfect dancer nahi hona hai, tujhe Shreya ki best friend hona hai.

Ek baat bataao — choreography start ho gayi hai ya abhi discuss karna hai? Aur tera roza routine kaisa hota hai energy-wise? Kyunki uske hisaab se hum practical plan bana sakte hain. 💛

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Yaar, yeh jo tune describe kiya — rassi wala metaphor — bilkul perfect hai. Aur sabse mushkil yeh hai ki dono taraf se pyaar hai, na koi villain hai. Isliye guilt aur confusion dono aa rahe hain.

Shreya ki baat sun — woh teri best friend hai, pandrah saal se saath chal rahi ho. Uska "ek din kya farak padta hai" woh compassion se aa raha hai. Woh yeh nahi soch rahi ki tere imaan ko tod de, woh bas yeh chahti hai ki tu uske din mein fully present ho. Uske liye yeh shaadi ek milestone hai aur tu uska emotional anchor. Woh logic se nahi, emotion se bol rahi hai.

Ammi ki baat bhi samajh — woh tere roze ki sanctity ke baare mein soch rahi hain. Unka perspective faith aur tradition se aa raha hai. Woh tujhe protect kar rahe hain, chahe unka tareeqa thoda rigid lage.

Ab tera darr asal mein kya hai? Mujhe lagta hai darr yeh nahi hai ki dance kaise karungi — darr yeh hai ki kisi ko disappoint nahi karna chahti. Shreya ko nahi, Ammi ko nahi.

Tujhe apna decision lena hoga — kisi aur ka woh burden nahi utha sakti. 

Ek baat soch — kya middle ground possible hai? Jaise tu roza rakhe, dance bhi kare, but practice timings aur energy ko smartly manage kare? Ya phir tujhe lagta hai Ammi se baat karni padegi thodi aur openly?

Kya soch rahi hai?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Yaar, main bilkul sun rahi hoon. Aur mujhe samajh bhi aa raha hai. Jab dono taraf se kheench jaati ho, toh escape hi sabse safe lagta hai. Draft wali baat — yeh exhaustion ka result hai, yeh teri character nahi hai.

Lekin ek baat sach bataungi, kyunki tu khud bhi yeh jaanti hai —

Shreya ko pandrah saal ka sapna hai. Uska opening dance. Aur tu usse door bhaagne ki soch rahi hai. Woh jab shaadi ke baad video dekhegi, aur tujhe stage pe nahi dekhegi — woh dard tujhse zyada usko hoga, bas woh shayad kabhi bolegi nahi.

Aur tu khud? Baad mein jab uski shaadi ki photos aayengi, aur tu wahan nahi hogi — yeh regret bohot heavy padta hai. Main dekha hai.

Dus aunties ki explanations se bhaagna easy lagta hai, but Shreya ki absence se nahi bhaag sakti.

Abhi draft mat bhej. Abhi ek din ruk. Soch — kya really impossible hai, ya tired hoke impossible kar rahi hai?

Tu bata, kya tujhe lagta hai Shreya se honest baat ki jaa sakti hai? Woh sun sakti hai?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yeh jo tune abhi kaha — yeh seene ke pathar ki baat — yeh sabse important cheez hai. Aur yehi baat tujhe bata rahi hai ki tu bhaag nahi sakti. Kyunki tu khud jaanti hai ki bhaagkar toh sirf yeh pathar aur bada ho jaata.

Atharah saal. Pehli baar. Yeh clash nahi hua hai, yeh waqt aa gaya hai ki dono cheezein ek saath khadi ho. Aur tujhe dono ko sambhalna hai, kisi ek ko chhod kar nahi.

Tu sad story nahi ban'na chahti — yeh bahut powerful realization hai. Iska matlab tu solution soch rahi hai, escape nahi.

Ek baat soch — Shreya ne "ek din kya farak padta hai" kaha tha. Agar tu uske saath baith ke, pyaar se, kahe ki "Shreya, main tere saath dance karungi, main tere saath hoon, bas mera roza rahega — mujhe is tarah schedule karna hoga" — toh kya woh sunegi?

Kyunki woh tujhse pyaar karti hai. Woh logic nahi, connection chahti hai. Agar tu usko de ke bhaagegi, woh samajhegi. Agar tu usko samjha ke rahegi, woh bhi samjhegi.

Ammi ko bhi thoda asaan bana sakte hain — "Ammi, main roza rakhungi, main dance karungi, main sab manage kar lungi. Aap dua karo bas."

Kya tujhe lagta hai — Shreya ke saath ek honest baat ho sakti hai? Woh itni mature hai na?
